evals.name: configure-plugin
evals.prompt: Add the Arc lint rules to our Node.js Arc for TypeScript server that already uses typescript-eslint and flat config. Give the config in your reply; do not write files.
evals.expected_output: Import @cratis/eslint-plugin-arc-core and spread arc.configs['recommended-type-checked'] after the typescript-eslint recommended config; mention the ESLint 10 and parser peers and running eslint src.
assertions: Imports the default export of @cratis/eslint-plugin-arc-core and uses configs['recommended-type-checked'].
Notes the preset needs type information and the plugin targets ESLint 10 flat config.
Says recommended works without type information but skips type-dependent checks.
Does not invent preset names other than recommended and recommended-type-checked.

evals.name: fix-missing-field
evals.prompt: eslint reports arc-core/missing-field on `title!: string;` in our @command() class. What does it mean and how do we fix it? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Public properties on @command() and @readModel() need @field so they appear in the wire schema; add @field(String); private and #/_ names are ignored.
assertions: Explains unmarked properties are invisible to the wire schema.
Notes private, # and underscore-prefixed names are ignored.
Does not recommend disabling the rule.

evals.name: chronicle-reactor-rule
evals.prompt: The type-checked preset reports arcchr0006 on a Chronicle reactor in our Arc for TypeScript server that returns commands. What does it want? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: A command-returning reactor must be marked once-only or supply a replay handler so replays do not re-run commands; decide replay explicitly instead of suppressing the lint.
assertions: Identifies arcchr0006 as a type-checked rule about command-returning reactors and replay.
Asks for an explicit once-only marker or a replay handler.
Recommends an explicit replay decision rather than a lint suppression.
